units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 11:28">Targ. Y. Gen. XI, 28</cite>.—Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ bot. <he>כל … מִילְחוֹשׁ לעיינה תיתי תִילְחוֹשִׁי</he> let any woman that knows how to cure a sore eye by charm, come forth and charm for me.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>עבדי גרמיך לַחֲשָׁה ליה וכ׳</he> act as if you were charming to him and you may spit into his eye; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:20">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:8">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ</cite> bot., a. e., v. <cite ref="J00680"><he>יֵשׁוּ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 12:19">Targ. II Sam. XII, 19</cite>.—Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ bot. <he>גחנין ומְלַחֲשִׁין</he> bending and whispering (a prayer).

senses.gloss: to be whispered to, be relieved by a whispered charm.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 82b:2">Yoma 82ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>לחושו לה … לחשו לה ואִילְּחִישָׁא</he> whisper to her that to-day is the Day of Atonement. They did whisper to her and she was relieved (of her morbid appetite); [Ms. O. <he>ואילחיש</he> and the embryo in her womb was quieted; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 10 a. 20].
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> [read] <he>ותִילְּחִישׁ</he> and listen, v. <cite ref="C00471"><he>גּוּץ</he></cite>.
